[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Apple Inc. operates a large data center campus in Prineville, Crook County, Oregon, announced in 2012 on a roughly 160 acre tract the company owns. This registry carries four rows, all generically named simply Apple, spread across that one campus with no distinguishing building labels. This session could not find a citable specific street address for the campus, let alone a way to distinguish which of the four rows represents which building. A Wikipedia article on Prineville, Oregon confirms the campus announcement but gives no address. A dedicated Baxtel listing for this facility confirms the Prineville, OR 97754 zip code but keeps its street address hidden behind a contact request rather than publishing it. A datacentermap.com area listing for Prineville could not be retrieved this session due to that sites own page view limit being reached. Datacenterdynamics.com and a local Bend Bulletin news search both returned 404 errors on guessed URLs, and datacenterHawk was inaccessible under its robots.txt rules. This sessions web search tool remained at its exhausted per session budget throughout, limiting research to direct page fetches on guessed or previously known URLs rather than fresh searches, which likely contributed to not finding a working source. Given no citable address was found for the campus at all, this session declined to assign an address to any of the four rows rather than rely on unverified prior knowledge.
